description: This Java class implements the ProductOptionDao interface, providing database access methods for ProductOption entities, including listing by store, getting by ID or code, and filtering based on read-only status or name, using QueryDSL for building dynamic queries.

classes.name: ProductOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductOptionDao for accessing ProductOption data from the database, using QueryDSL and extends generic DAO class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptions associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOption entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Finds ProductOptions matching a name pattern within a given store and language.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOptions marked as read-only for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new ProductOption or updates an existing one, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Finds a ProductOption by its code within a specific store.
